target_customer: Employers in Asia Pacific buying employee mental wellness benefits
problem: Corporate Asia has high burnout and low usage of traditional employee assistance programs. MindFi offers an app with therapy, coaching, self-help and HR analytics, localized across languages.
business_model: B2B pay-per-use and custom budget contracts with employers
product_category: Workplace mental health and wellness platform

founders.name: Bjorn Lee
founders.background_notes: YC description says Bjorn is an ex-Zendesk product manager; TechNode and e27 identify Bjorn Lee as CEO.

founders.name: Gangeshwar Krishnamurthy
founders.background_notes: YC page: AI scientist turned founder.

founders.name: Leon CK Leong
previous_startups: Two tech startups co-founded and sold (names not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: runs business development and client success.

competitors.name: Intellect
competitors.what: Singapore mental health platform for employers and consumers
competitors.traction_then: 20x year on year revenue growth in 2021 (company claim)
competitors.funding_then: 13M total including a 10M Series A in January 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile app with provider marketplace, chat and analytics; standard engineering. The AI features were stated as planned uses of seed funds.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise contracts and localization across languages and providers help, but the offering resembles other EAP platforms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move against MindFi was found.

market_need_then: COVID increased demand for mental wellness services; founder Bjorn Lee discussed rising demand in a KrASIA interview. Employers such as Visa, Willis Towers Watson and Patsnap signed on.

branding.domain_note: Operates at mindfi.co, not the exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and people focused: Built differently, for you

branding.brand_signature: Mind fitness framing (Singapore press describes bringing mind fitness to workplaces)

brand_strength.rationale: Brand searches found only funding news; no mascot, merch or community evidence. The name hints at wellness and finance but resembles other Mind- names.

outcome_analysis: MindFi joined YC in Summer 2021, raised a $750K pre-seed in August 2021 and a $2M seed in February 2022, and reported enterprise clients such as Visa and Willis Towers Watson. No later funding, layoffs, acquisition or shutdown was found, so the company appears to be a small active startup that has not announced a larger round. Competitor Intellect raised a $10M Series A months later, a sign the segment was crowded and well funded.
notes: Pre-seed investors come from search summaries of TechNode and MobiHealthNews; Patsnap CEO and Koh Boon Hwee are named in an e27 headline as joining, not recorded as lead. Intellect source is dated January 2022, about six months after the batch. Psychologist Anita Sadasivan appears in the YC description as team, not as a founder. Outcome search found nothing after 2022.
